title: Reunions of Hines alumni
summary: Parties when Earl came to town.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: When he used to come to town, I remember I was working with Truck some place. And a lot of the guys who had been through the band would have a party for Earl, sort of like a reunion.
What were those like? And, you know, who put them together? Was there sort of like a club of ex-Earl --
Yeah, that was mostly done by guys
like George Dixon and Willie Randall, (P- U-)
And everybody would get together when Earl came to town?
Just sit around and talk and drink. Talk about old times.
Yeah. Do any playing at those sessions?
There's a lot of the ex-Hines band still around town. Have you all stayed in touch, much.
Very seldom. George and I keep in touch with each other every now and then, through a mutual acquaintance. Works the same place George works, downtown at the police headquarters.
